mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NOTIFICATIONS (USER_ID, TYPE, TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_ID, TITLE, IS_READ) SELECT USER_ID, 'NOTICE', 'POST', #{targetId}, #{title}, FALSE FROM `users` WHERE USER_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT NOTIFICATION_ID AS notificationId, USER_ID AS userId, TYPE AS type, TARGET_TYPE AS targetType, TARGET_ID AS targetId, TITLE AS title, IS_READ AS isRead, CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM NOTIFICATIONS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
